interface.description: Network interface to use for sending the Magic Packet. Must be an existing interface on the system.

broadcast.description: If true, send the Wake-on-LAN packet to the broadcast address. Required for most WOL implementations.

debug.description: If true, enable verbose debug output (increases logging level).

password.description: Optional 4-byte (dotted decimal, e.g., '192.168.1.1') or 6-byte (Ethernet hex, e.g., '00:22:44:66:88:aa') WOL password. Only supported on certain NICs.

hosts.description: List of target devices to wake. Each item is a MAC address (e.g., '00:11:22:33:44:55') or a hostname/resolvable ID recognized by ethers(5).
